data.description:
## Description

**What**: Replace plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md with a thin orchestrator that runs four phases (init, dialogue, architect-foundation, generate-claude-md) in order. Each phase is gated by its freshness predicate per the S0 contract. The orchestrator writes the phase-invocation log artifact to \${WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR}/onboarding-phases.log per the S0 schema. Inline existing skill logic (currently in /dso:init, /dso:architect-foundation, /dso:generate-claude-md SKILL.md files) into skills/onboarding/phases/<phase>.md as a first cut — full prompt-file decomposition is deferred to S4.

**Why**: This is the walking skeleton — the minimum end-to-end path that makes the resume behavior real. Once the orchestrator runs and the log writes, all four resume cases (S1's fixtures) become demonstrable and the GREEN side of TDD is reachable.

**Scope**:
- IN: New orchestrator SKILL.md; phases/init.md, phases/dialogue.md, phases/architect-foundation.md, phases/generate-claude-md.md (logic inlined verbatim from current skills); freshness-predicate implementation per S0's contract; phase-invocation log writer; behavior on unresolvable \${WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR} (create the directory if absent; fail loudly with diagnostic if creation fails); behavior on malformed input artifacts (predicate fails loudly with helpful error, halts orchestrator). Walking skeleton: end-to-end path makes S1's RED tests pass GREEN.
- OUT: Deletion of /dso:init, /dso:architect-foundation, /dso:generate-claude-md skill directories (S3). Conditional-content decomposition into prompts/<topic>.md (S4). Cross-reference cleanup (S5).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, /dso:onboarding on a fully set-up project (all four phase artifacts present and pass their freshness checks) writes no files and surfaces no dialog questions; phase-invocation log shows all four phases with outcome=noop
  ← Satisfies: "Running /dso:onboarding on a fully set-up project ... writes no files and surfaces no dialog questions."
- When this story is complete, /dso:onboarding after editing workflow-config.yaml re-renders only CLAUDE.md; SHA256 of project-understanding.md and enforcement-scaffolding files unchanged; phase-invocation log shows generate-claude-md outcome=executed with invocation_reason=dependent_artifact_changed
  ← Satisfies: "Running /dso:onboarding after editing workflow-config.yaml re-renders only CLAUDE.md."
- When this story is complete, /dso:onboarding after deleting project-understanding.md runs only the dialogue and architect-foundation phases; phase-invocation log shows exactly init=noop, dialogue=executed, architect-foundation=executed, generate-claude-md=noop
  ← Satisfies: "Running /dso:onboarding after deleting project-understanding.md runs only the dialogue and architect-foundation phases."
- When this story is complete, S1's tests/scripts/test-onboarding-resume.sh runs and all four cases PASS (GREEN)
  ← Satisfies: TDD GREEN phase for SC1, SC2, SC3, SC9 fixture (a-d).

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Phase-invocation log is the verification artifact for SC1-SC3. Its schema is authoritative in S0 — the orchestrator must conform to that schema, not redefine it.
- [Reliability] On unresolvable \${WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR}: orchestrator creates the directory if absent, falls back to a session-stable temp dir if creation fails, and emits a diagnostic on stderr — never silently swallows the log write.
- [Reliability] Freshness predicate must fail loudly on malformed inputs (e.g., YAML syntax error in workflow-config.yaml) — emit a clear error pointing at the file and line; do NOT silently treat malformed input as fresh or stale.
- [Testing] Orchestrator's phase boundaries must be testable in isolation — each phase's freshness predicate should be invocable via a dedicated entry point (or testable via fixture-project setup), not only as part of the full skill invocation.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a project maintainer, /dso:onboarding intelligently no-ops, partially-runs, or fully-runs based on detected artifact state
